description: The fourth engine again, `chrome`, and beside the image a step that names it — `npx playwright install-deps chrome chromium firefox webkit`. That installs the engines' system libraries and no browser at all, so chrome is still missing. A reader that took `install-deps` for `install` would count the step and let the case through to point 6.

chrome.$why: A branded channel of blink, with only its libraries installed.

ciText:
jobs:
  # Playwright's image, mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, at the lockfile's version.
  gates:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble # the tag before the bump: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: npx playwright install-deps chrome chromium firefox webkit
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected -t lint test build check-browsers
  e2e:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }} -t e2e
